project_type: Full-stack web app: React+Vite frontend, Express.js backend (currently SQLite, migrating to PostgreSQL)
build_system: npm for both frontend and backend; Vite for frontend bundling
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/anotnigeia && npm run build (frontend); cd /projects/sandbox/anotnigeia/server && node index.js (backend)
test_command: No tests exist. Verification is via successful server startup and frontend build.
verification_instructions: 1. Install frontend deps and run 'npm run build' to confirm frontend compiles. 2. Install server deps and run 'node index.js' briefly to confirm it starts without errors (needs DATABASE_URL set).
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/anotnigeia && npm install. 2. cd server && npm install.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - can install packages freely. No Docker needed for verification.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Standard practices apply.
key_patterns: Backend: Express.js with middleware (helmet, cors, rate-limit), JWT auth, synchronous SQLite via better-sqlite3. Frontend: React with zustand stores, service layer in src/services/api.ts using relative '/api' path (relies on Vite proxy in dev). Vite config has proxy from /api to localhost:3001.
directory_structure: Root: React+Vite app (package.json, vite.config.ts, src/, index.html). server/: Express backend (index.js, package.json, Procfile). src/services/api.ts: API client. src/stores/: zustand stores for auth, user, blog.
